scope: fixed grouped train-OOF only: 70 images / 59 specimen groups

fp_decomposition.zero_overlap_fp_pixels: FP pixels in components with zero same-class GT overlap
fp_decomposition.overlap_fp_pixels: FP pixels in components with nonzero same-class GT overlap
fp_decomposition.all_component_fp_pixels: sum of the preceding two categories

gt_presence_strata.gt_present: image has at least one GT pixel of the target class
gt_presence_strata.gt_absent: image has zero GT pixels of the target class
gt_presence_strata.metric_note: With official empty-union=0, target-class IoU is 0 in either absent-class case; FP changes can still affect other classes through argmax competition.

model407_oof_lock_record.metric_scope: 70 train images/59 specimen groups; official valid/test excluded

interpretation: Descriptive only; does not alter Model407's preregistered score or GO/NO-GO gate.
